name: dsh-launcher-monorepo
description: dsh-launcher monorepo — hosts the three @dshl/* npm packages (control aggregator + native/pipe backends) so they can be linked, developed, and tested together. The Rust workspace lives at the same root; the packages here are only the JS plugin track.

scripts.check: node --check plugins/dshl-control/src/index.js && node --check plugins/dshl-control/src/plugin-guard.js && node --check plugins/dshl-control/src/ui.js && node --check plugins/dshl-native/src/index.js && node --check plugins/dshl-native/src/loader.js && node --check plugins/dshl-native/scripts/build-native.mjs && node --check plugins/dshl-pipe/src/index.js && node --check plugins/dshl-pipe/src/client.js
scripts.publish:all: npm run check && npm pack --workspaces --dry-run && npm publish -w plugins/dshl-native --access public && npm publish -w plugins/dshl-pipe --access public && npm publish -w plugins/dshl-control --access public
